svg.title: Supply box wiring
svg.desc: Supply box: mains, S-100-5, own tower's 74AHCT125 to 4 JST-SM strands, neighbour power and data. Generated by tools/wiring_diagrams.py; do not edit.
svg.text: Supply box — A, B, D, E (and C, inside the apex box)
Mains in, the box's own tower out on 4 JST-SM (one per face), and for boxes A and E the
neighbouring tip tower's power (XT60) and buffered data. Same pixels on all 4 faces.
Boxes A and E only: the neighbouring tip tower (A → T1; E → T7)
22 AWG pair (DATA + GND) to its tower
A: to T1 · E: to T7
All flags with the same label are the same wire. The data inputs' 5V pins stay unconnected so two supplies never join on +5 V.
Box C: the same circuit inside the apex box (its own tower is T4), plus the perfboard feed for the ESP32 / transceivers.
100 Ω resistors optional. The neighbours' data shares one buffer gate per tower; it is split to 4 faces at that tower's base.
